description: Land Title Settlement Department - Polgaha anga, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District   - Cad. Map No. 320240
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership details, and specific land-related determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, property rights, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
